instrument: Arizona FY2027 budget legislation (reported as HB 4168 / SB 1861)
summary: The Arizona Commerce Authority may not accept data center sales-tax exemption applications from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029. Existing recipients keep their exemptions; construction is not restricted.
notes: Governor's office savings estimate about $57 million (ABC15 via Newsweek). Finding candidate: 113 applications were filed June 15-30 2026 against 123 in the program's prior ~13 years (Axios Phoenix via DMNews); ACA has 60 days per application, so approvals land after the pause begins. Same session: a utility large-load interconnection reporting bill signed; the Marana referral bill vetoed (bill numbers not pulled).
confidence_note: Bill number from MultiState; confirm against azleg.gov. Application counts reported, not confirmed with ACA. A Bloomberg Tax page carries a Jan 13 2026 timestamp inconsistent with every other source; treated as metadata error.

source.citation: MultiState; ABC15 via Newsweek; Axios Phoenix via DMNews; Arizona Capitol Times (June 2026)
